authorship.reason: Registers protocol v2's normative terms natively; the frozen documents themselves are unchanged.

limitations: A reconstruction of a published computation under stated assumptions, not a measurement of nature: the integrator ordering is inferred and no author code exists.
The comparison reference is a digitization of the printed figure with stated uncertainty, never the original MANIAC output.

semantic.analysis: M1: first mode-1 recurrence time — argmax of E_1 over cycles 20000 through 30000; tolerance "absolute difference <= 1000 cycles". M2: recurrence energy fraction — E_1(t_rec)/E_1(0); tolerance "absolute difference <= 0.03". M3: global maxima of modes 2, 3, and 4 — time and height of the global maximum of each of modes 2, 3, and 4 over cycles 0 through 20,000 (the labelled major peaks in the figure); tolerance {"height": "within 10 percent of E_1(0), using the report-axis normalization", "time": "within 5 percent of the digitized time"}. M4: higher-mode ceiling (per mode) — max over cycles 0-30,000 and over modes 6 through 31 of the single-mode energy; tolerance "pass if <= 20/300 = 0.0666666667 of E_1(0)". Controls — C1: Set alpha=0 and verify E_1 remains within 1 percent of its initial value over 10000 cycles. Pass: max relative deviation <= 0.01 (gating). C2: Include the quadratic and cubic spring potential terms and measure maximum relative total-energy drift over the 30000-cycle baseline. Pass: max relative drift <= 0.01 (gating). C3: Repeat with dt/2 while holding physical elapsed time fixed, and compare the recurrence time after converting both runs to physical time. Pass: relative movement in t_rec < 0.01 (reported).
semantic.assumptions: The report's statement that derivatives were replaced by difference expressions is reconstructed as a position-space Störmer–Verlet / velocity-Verlet update; no author code is available. The caption's delta t^2=1/8 is read as the acceleration coefficient, so dt=1/sqrt(8); the alternative dt=1/8 reading is exploratory only. The plotted modal energy omits the nonlinear potential term as the report's own mode analysis does. The comparison reference is a digitization of the printed figure with stated uncertainty (±250 cycles, ±5 report units for individually numeraled peaks), not the original MANIAC output. Arithmetic is IEEE-754 float64 with no random seed and no adaptive stepping.

design.baseline: The registered protocol-v2 reconstruction at the report's own parameters.

convergence.criterion: Control C3: halve dt at equal physical duration and compare the physical recurrence time; reported, not gating, under protocol v2.

decision.metric: absolute difference between the measured and digitized recurrence cycle
decision.rule: M1 within ±1000 cycles and M2 within ±0.03 support the reproduction; a miss is reported as a discrepancy and never tuned away.

semantic.exclusions: No smoothing, prominence threshold or feature-selection rule derived from the reference curves. No parameter is fitted to the figure. Exploratory readings (alpha != 0.25, dt != 1/sqrt(8), shortened cycle budgets) are excluded from the baseline and live only in explicitly labelled exploratory runs.

holdout.policy: The digitized Fig. 1 reference is frozen by SHA-256 before the run and is read only for the named comparison features; no baseline parameter is derived from it.

semantic.question: Does an independent Störmer–Verlet reconstruction of the α-FPUT chain (quadratic Fermi-Pasta-Ulam chain, N=32, alpha=0.25, dt=1/sqrt(8)) reproduce the mode-energy features of LA-1940 Fig. 1 within the frozen tolerances, without tuning any parameter to the digitized figure?
semantic.stopping_rule: Execute exactly 30000 cycles, sampling every 50 cycles, inside the 120 second bounded timeout. A failed or inconclusive baseline is retained as an auditable run and is never silently retried with adjusted parameters.
